CaptureBudget.description: Capture configuration. These defaults configure optional work, never missing facts.

memory_bytes.description: In-process exporter working allowance. External tools have their own working sets.

output_bytes.description: Total retained capture file allowance, including raw samples and converted profiles.

description: Structured launch request. A new command is independently owned from its CPU capture.

argv.description: Executable and arguments passed directly, never interpolated as shell source.

budget.description: Existing finite capture/output allowances; never limits scientific execution.

cwd.description: Optional command working directory. It does not change the capture output location.

duration.description: Finite sampling interval after acknowledged activation, at most one hour.

output.description: Fresh directory exclusively owned by the optional capture.

startup_timeout.description: Finite allowance for establishing acknowledged sampling, at most one minute.

title: LaunchCaptureRequest
